name: Kudoyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kudoyama town emblem in red: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Kudoyama, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kudoyama town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrowhead
